reason: The telescope conflates two distinct products. The bilinear identity bc-b'c'=(b-b')c+b'(c-c') uses the original multiplication of A. But when lem-compcb-rectangular-product is applied inside A_R=S_R, its ambient multiplication is the compressed R-product supplied by lem-compcb-corner-algebra, so it bounds ||b' dot_R c'-b' dot_a c'||, not ||b'c' (in A)-b' dot_a c'||. The missing term ||b'c' (in A)-b' dot_R c'|| requires a separate application of lem-compcb-rectangular-product in A to the compatible R,R corners. Without that term, the asserted sum does not telescope and the displayed inference is invalid.
